questions.stem: A point $(-1, 4)$ is rotated $90°$ anticlockwise about the origin. What are the coordinates of the image?
questions.explanation: A $90°$ anticlockwise rotation about the origin maps $(x, y) \to (-y, x)$. So $(-1, 4) \to (-4, -1)$.

questions.stem: A shape is rotated $90°$ clockwise about a point, then rotated $90°$ clockwise about the same point again. What single transformation is this equivalent to?
questions.explanation: Two successive $90°$ clockwise rotations about the same centre combine to give a $180°$ rotation about that centre ($90° + 90° = 180°$).
